prompt: Open https://example.com and report the exact text of the page's main heading.
criterion: The agent reports the heading text 'Example Domain'.

prompt: On https://example.com, find the only hyperlink and report both its visible text and the URL it points to.
criterion: The agent reports link text 'More information...' or 'Learn more' and a URL on iana.org.

prompt: Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rust_(programming_language) and report the first sentence of the article body.
criterion: The agent reports the article's opening sentence with its substance intact: it must name Rust as a general-purpose programming language and mention performance, type safety, concurrency, and memory safety. Wording identical to the article counts as correct; do not require surrounding quotation marks or a citation.

prompt: On the Wikipedia article for the Rust programming language, find in the infobox who originally designed Rust and report the name.
criterion: The agent reports Graydon Hoare as the original designer.

prompt: Start at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rust_(programming_language), click the link to the Mozilla article, and report the title of the page you land on.
criterion: The agent reports the destination page title for Mozilla (for example "Mozilla" or "Mozilla - Wikipedia"). Reaching the destination is the requirement; do not demand a visible click log or tool transcript, which the agent's final answer does not include.

prompt: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org, use the site's own search box to search for 'WebAssembly', and report the title of the resulting article.
criterion: The agent reports the resulting article title "WebAssembly". Reaching the right article is the requirement; do not demand a visible search-box interaction or tool transcript, which the agent's final answer does not include.

prompt: Open https://httpbingo.org/forms/post, choose 'large' in the pizza size field, type 'Maho Bench' into the customer name field, submit the form, and report whether the response page echoes 'Maho Bench'.
criterion: The agent fills the form, submits it, and reports that the response echoes 'Maho Bench'.
replacement_reason: The live HTTPBin form is reachable by GET but browser navigation and submission repeatedly time out on this Chromium build. HTTPBingo is a public HTTPBin-compatible service exposing the same HTML5 form and POST echo behavior, preserving radio selection, text entry, submission, navigation, and echo verification at the same difficulty.

prompt: On the Wikipedia article for the Rust programming language, report how many top-level sections the table of contents lists.
criterion: The agent reports a specific numeric count derived from the page's table of contents.

prompt: Starting from https://example.com, navigate through its link to the IANA site, and report the main heading text of the destination page.
criterion: The agent reports the destination page's heading, which is the PLURAL "Example Domains" on iana.org. Note that example.com's own heading is the SINGULAR "Example Domain"; reporting the plural form proves the agent reached iana.org, so count it as a pass. Only the singular form alone is a failure.

prompt: Open the Wikipedia articles for the Rust and Go programming languages, and report which one lists an earlier first-appeared year, including both years.
criterion: The agent reports both years and correctly identifies Go (2009) as earlier than Rust (2010 or later).
